method: rank fixture ids by sha256(id) ascending, take the first 10 (~20%), then sort for readability
why: deterministic and auditable so the sample cannot be accused of cherry-picking, and uncorrelated with class ordering — a simple stride would have sampled the class-grouped corpus unevenly
ratifiedBy: D-011(c): a second fresh labeller re-labels a random ~20% sample; the disagreement rate is reported at S2
